videos.title: ShopMill Setup and Programming 840D 828D
topics_covered: Jog mode operation and TSM screen
Tool creation with named tools (not number-limited)
Stock removal turning cycle (facing and OD)
Threading cycle with variable speed support
Auto mode execution and block search
Q&A: ShopTurn cannot convert to G-code

tool_management.naming: Tools can have full text names (not limited to numbers). Example: 'CNMG_432_3-32_OD'. Supports letters, numbers, forward slashes, special characters.
tool_management.max_tools: Builder-selectable, typically 99 loaded positions but control supports thousands of tools total
tool_management.cutting_edges: Each tool supports up to 9 unique offsets (D1-D9). Multiple cutting edges can be completely different tool types on same turret position (e.g., gang tool with turning, threading, and parting tools)
tool_management.loaded_vs_unloaded: Tools can exist in loaded (in machine) or unloaded (stored but not in machine) states
tool_management.tool_library: Comprehensive library: favorites, end mills, drills, taps, turning tools, probes, grooving tools, right angle heads, die/mold cutters

insert_parameters.insert_angle: Physical insert angle (e.g., 35 for VNMG, 80 for CNMG)
insert_parameters.cutting_direction: Primary and secondary cutting directions, system validates orientation

setup_workflow.jog_mode: Primary screen for machine movement, tool changes, offset setting. Designed for simplicity — no MDI G-code commands needed
setup_workflow.tsm_screen: Tool/Spindle/M-code screen. Handles tool changes, spindle start/stop with direction, work coordinate loading, coolant control, unit measure changes. All actions require physical cycle start

measure_tool.manual_method: Jog to part, take light cut, measure diameter, enter diametric value in X0 field (system halves it automatically), press Set Length. Repeat for Z axis
measure_tool.offset_verification: After setting offset, ALWAYS verify display reflects change. If it doesn't, stop and troubleshoot
measure_tool.tip: Can stay within measure tool screen for multiple tool setups — just select next tool and cycle start

measure_workpiece.purpose: Sets work coordinate offsets. Moves ALL tools by same amount
measure_workpiece.workflow: Touch part with tool, select work coordinate (G54-G59), enter value, press Set Work Coordinate
measure_workpiece.use_case: Pre-establish all tools to base datum, then use measure workpiece to shift everything to new part

nc_memory_structure.workpieces: Can create subdirectories, support any file types including PDFs

program_management.naming_rules: Letters, numbers, and underscores ONLY. No spaces, dashes, or other special characters
program_management.file_transfer: USB, CF card, mapped network drives. Copy/paste between locations. Can edit files on remote storage
program_management.usb_warning: USB not recommended for normal production — insecure connection, unreliable sticks. Use for emergencies only
program_management.setup_data_save: Can save tool table + offsets + work coordinates as a file alongside part program

header_page.blank_definition: Cylinder, pipe, square, hex stock with dimensions (for simulation only)
header_page.stock_dimensions: OD, Z start (positive for facing stock), Z length, Z from chuck jaws
header_page.retract: Incremental or absolute. Incremental preferred except for ID boring where absolute to smallest bore diameter is safer
header_page.tool_change_point: Unique to turning — defines physical tool change location. Can use machine coordinates with teach position or work coordinate relative values
header_page.safety_clearance: Distance from part before feeding begins
header_page.climb_vs_conventional: Default milling direction for live tooling

stock_removal_cycle.parameters: Tool, feed (per rev or per min), speed (RPM or CSS), rough/finish, OD/ID/face/turning, start/end dimensions, depth per pass, finish allowance (U fields)
stock_removal_cycle.interrupted_feed: DI parameter — linear distance at which system breaks chip by stopping servo momentarily
stock_removal_cycle.blank_control: BL parameter controls actual machining envelope (not header blank which is simulation only). Options: simple cylinder, contour, or allowance-based machining from cast/pre-machined parts
stock_removal_cycle.relief_handling: System respects insert geometry and never overcuts. Uses insert checking for undercut detection
stock_removal_cycle.residual_material: Picks different tool to machine areas where primary tool couldn't fit. System auto-detects remaining material

contour_editor.elements: Lines (single/two-axis), arcs (with tangent), chamfers, radii at corners
contour_editor.dimension_modes: Absolute or incremental per axis, can mix within same element
contour_editor.tangent_function: Arc tangent to previous element — auto-calculates center point
contour_editor.dialogue_select: Chooses between two possible arc solutions (short/long segment)
contour_editor.coordinate_display: System always calculates resulting angles and positions

threading.parameters: Pitch (threads per inch or metric), OD/ID start/end, thread height, in-feed angle, first cut depth, finish allowance, spring cuts, lead advance
threading.css_threading: Control supports constant surface speed threading (builder-dependent)
threading.variable_speed_threading: Spindle override is live during threading — can adjust speed while cutting thread
threading.multi_lead_threads: Supported with lead count and starting angle control
threading.taper_threads: Supported for both OD and ID
threading.chain_threads: Pitch and shape can change over length of thread

cutoff_parting.insert_width: System auto-compensates for back side of parting tool
cutoff_parting.speed_reduction: FS field: at specified diameter, reduce feed rate and switch to constant RPM at specified value
cutoff_parting.chamfer_radius: Can add chamfer (FS) or radius (R) to parted face

auto_mode.entry_methods: Execute button from program manager or Auto mode button
auto_mode.block_search: Start from any point in program — highlight position determines start point. Reset key rewinds
auto_mode.basic_blocks: Shows resulting G-code lines from conversational cycles

program_control.dry_run: Run program without part in machine
program_control.rapid_reduction: Slow down G0 rapid moves for new machines
program_control.single_block_fine: Stops at every motion or command
program_control.single_block_rough: Allows canned cycles to complete, stops between operations

auto_mode.simultaneous_record: Real-time graphics display during actual cutting
auto_mode.sync_thread: Thread repair function — orient spindle to existing thread lead by engaging tool and pressing teach spindle

videos.title: Shop Floor Programming 101 with ShopMill
topics_covered: ShopMill interface overview and program creation
Face milling cycle with feed per tooth calculation
Center drilling with countersink diameter calculation
Position strategies (random, bolt hole pattern, row, grid, frame)
Thread milling with calculated cutter feed
Simulation with show path, speed control, sectional views

shopmill_header.unit_of_measure: Inch or Metric — toggle with Select key
shopmill_header.stock_definition: Cylinder, pipe, block (center origin), block (corner origin), multi-sided, none
shopmill_header.block_corner_setup: Two opposing corners define stock. Accommodate for rough stock overage (e.g., 1/8 inch per side for 1/4 inch oversize stock)
shopmill_header.tool_plane: G17/G18/G19 — affects drilling orientation for right angle heads
shopmill_header.retract_plane: Where tool goes after each operation. Absolute Z value above part
shopmill_header.safety_distance: Incremental approach distance before feeding. Unsigned value
shopmill_header.machining_state: Down cut = climb milling, Up cut = conventional milling
shopmill_header.retract_optimization: Always retract to plane vs optimize (only retract when necessary)

tool_creation.process: Select tool → Tool List → New Tool → Pick type from library → Name → Parameters → To Program
tool_creation.face_mill: Length, diameter, number of teeth, spindle direction, coolant on/off. Further data: body diameter for wall clearance
tool_creation.end_mill: Length, diameter, number of flutes, direction, coolant. Diameter symbol vs radius depends on machine parameter
tool_creation.drills: Length, diameter, tip angle (critical for depth compensation). Feed per rev mode
tool_creation.taps: Length, diameter, pitch. Pitch in inch mode = threads per inch, metric mode = metric pitch value. Fraction support for fractional pitches (e.g., 20.5 TPI = 21/2)
tool_creation.thread_mills: Under cutter library. Diameter, number of flutes/teeth, depth per tooth
tool_creation.center_drills: True NC spot drill style. Countersink angle critical for automatic depth calculation from spot diameter
tool_creation.d_number: D1 is default single offset. D2-D9 for multiple offsets per tool. D column in offset table

face_mill.auto_fill: Only cycle that pulls dimensions from header page
face_mill.parameters: Tool, feed (per tooth or per minute), speed (RPM or CSS), rough/finish, cutter direction (bi/uni in X and Y), start/end XYZ, step over (% or distance), finish allowance
face_mill.css_calculation: Enter surface footage and feed per tooth — system calculates RPM and feed per minute automatically

spigot_boss.pattern: Single position or linked pattern for multiple identical features
spigot_boss.parameters: Center XY, top Z, rough/finish dimensions, corner radius, angle, depth, depth per pass, finish allowance UX/UY/UZ

pocket.circular_strategies: Helical (continuous spiral — better chip evacuation for deep holes) or plane-by-plane (step down and spiral out)
pocket.helical_parameters: Lead-in pitch (ramp angle), radial engagement percentage
pocket.removed_material: Accommodate pre-drilled holes to avoid wasting time machining air. Unsigned depth value, cannot exceed cycle depth

slot.types: Longitudinal (encapsulated/captured key), circumferential (wrapped around radius), open slot (trochoidal)
slot.circumferential_params: Center XY, Z start, number of slots, radius, start/end angles, slot width, slot depth, depth per pass, positioning strategy (shortest path or follow radius)
slot.full_vs_partial: Full circle = auto-indexed equally. Partial = specify start/end for each

thread_mill.feed_calculation: Control calculates true cutter edge feed from linear feed rate using formula: F_actual = F_programmed * (D_thread / D_thread_mill) for OD, inverse for ID
thread_mill.parameters: Feed per tooth or linear, RPM/CSS, rough/finish, top-down or bottom-up, right/left hand, ID/OD, number of teeth per revolution, ending diameter, thread height, depth per pass, radial engagement, finish allowance
thread_mill.position_required: Must add drilling position event to define XY location — thread mill event has no XY fields
thread_mill.thread_height_calc: Example: 1 inch - 0.875 bore = 0.125 total, thread height = 0.0625 (half)

center_drilling.depth_modes: True tip depth or countersink diameter (system calculates depth from tip angle and spot diameter)
center_drilling.dwell: Optional dwell at bottom for breakthrough

deep_hole_drilling.strategies: Chip breaking (stop servo, break chip, continue) or chip removal (full retract from hole)
deep_hole_drilling.depth_compensation: Tip or shank. Shank = drill deeper than Z1 by tip projection. Tip = drill to exactly Z1
deep_hole_drilling.progressive_reduction: Percentage field reduces each subsequent peck depth
deep_hole_drilling.first_feed: Separate slower feed rate and depth for initial engagement

tapping.rigid_tapping: Without compensating chuck. Allows peck tapping
tapping.soft_tapping: With floating tap holder. Single cut only, no peck option
tapping.thread_types: Threads per inch, module, metric pitch, inch pitch. Fraction support for half-pitches

drill_ream.behavior: Rapid to hole, feed to depth, controlled feed retract out

position_strategies.random_holes: Up to 9 locations per event (0-8). Delete all to clear

bolt_hole_pattern.parameters: Center XY, Z datum, radius, first hole angle (0=3 o'clock, 90=12 o'clock, counterclockwise), number of holes
bolt_hole_pattern.positioning: Shortest path or follow radius arc

position_strategies.row: Linear row of equally spaced holes
position_strategies.repeat_positions: Reference previous position set by number — single source of truth for geometry
position_strategies.z_datum: Each position set specifies its own Z0, allowing different planes (e.g., holes on top surface at Z0 and holes in pocket at Z-0.5)

additional_features.g_code_insertion: Insert any G-code line in middle of conversational program via input key
additional_features.msg_command: MSG("text") displays operator message on screen. MSG("") clears message. Persists until cleared or replaced
additional_features.optional_stop: Under machine functions. Program stop = M01 (needs flag), Stop command = M00 (always stops)
additional_features.build_group: Consolidate multiple events into collapsible group for readability
additional_features.sequence_numbers: Renumber command adds N-numbers. Settings option for auto-insert. Useful for alarm troubleshooting
additional_features.ctrl_g: Quick wireframe graphic view — highlights show which event corresponds to which geometry

cycle_time.simulation: Total cycle time shown after simulation completes
cycle_time.per_operation: Enable 'determined machine times' in settings for per-block or per-group breakdown
cycle_time.auto_recording: In auto mode: settings → record cycle time to save to file

in_process_measuring.option_required: License option for auto mode measuring. Jog mode measuring is standard
in_process_measuring.capabilities: Measure parts, create reports, reset work coordinates, check tool breakage, resize for wear

straight_circle.purpose: Point-to-point tool path for geometry that doesn't fit canned cycles
straight_circle.elements: Tool changes, straight line moves, circular arc moves

additional_features.high_speed_machining: Available under Various → Settings for CYCLE832 activation

videos.title: 5-axis 3+2 G-code Programming with ProgramGuide
videos.focus: CYCLE800 swivel cycle for 3+2 indexed 5-axis programming in G-code
topics_covered: Coordinate rotations vs direct axis offsets
Swivel cycle in jog mode for setup
CYCLE800 programming (axis-by-axis, projected angles, direct axis)
Retract strategies (Z retract, max tool direction, incremental)
Linear shifts before and after rotation
Collision avoidance with machine space model
Cycle mask validation for posted programs
Job planning manual for external cycle programming
String variable for swivel data name portability

five_axis_setup.sequence: CRITICAL: Always follow this order: 1) Align Plane (square head to surface), 2) Align Edge (indicate edge), 3) Set Zero (find part datum). Skipping order causes offset errors because rotary motion invalidates previous measurements

align_plane.method: Probe 3 points on surface. Writes coordinate rotation offsets to active work coordinate (G54-G59)
align_plane.offset_location: Details section of work coordinate — coordinate rotations about X, Y, Z linear axes
align_plane.note: Machine does NOT physically move rotaries — only calculates and stores offset values

align_edge.methods: Coordinate rotation (writes to rotation fields) or direct axis (writes to A/C axis offset)
align_edge.warning: NEVER mix coordinate rotation and direct axis methods — offsets fight each other. Keep consistent with programming method

coordinate_rotations.concept: Rotation about linear axes (not direct rotary positioning). Every machine has XYZ so programs are portable
coordinate_rotations.location: Work coordinate Details button → rotation fields for X, Y, Z

wcs_mcs_jogging.MCS_mode: Jog relative to machine coordinate system. Moving X physically moves only X motor
wcs_mcs_jogging.WCS_mode: Jog relative to rotated work coordinate system. Moving X may require multiple motors to track along rotated X direction
wcs_mcs_jogging.use_case: WCS mode essential for indicating edges after coordinate rotation is applied. Enables tracking along rotated planes

cycle800_swivel_cycle.purpose: Creates inclined work planes and orients tool perpendicular to them. Work coordinate system moves to new plane

two_modes.plane_rotation: Creates plane, moves UCS to surface, Z perpendicular to plane. Used for 3+2 milling
two_modes.tool_orientation: Tips tool angle but UCS stays fixed. Used for 5-axis lathes and freeform surfaces

cycle800_swivel_cycle.three_steps: 1) Linear shift of zero, 2) Rotation about axes, 3) Second linear shift on new plane

supported: Mixed (one rotary in head, one in table)
Table-table (both rotaries in table, e.g., trunnion)
Nutated axes (rotary not perpendicular to linear)
machine_kinematics.same_cycle: Identical CYCLE800 syntax works on ALL kinematic types — control automatically calculates required motion

axis_by_axis.concept: Describe rotation about X, Y, Z linear axes. Portable to any 5-axis machine
axis_by_axis.rotation_sequence: ORDER MATTERS for compound rotations. XYZ vs ZYX gives different results. Single rotation = order irrelevant
axis_by_axis.best_practice: Pick axis you want to rotate about first

direct_axis.concept: Directly specify A, B, C rotary positions. ONLY runs on machines with matching rotary configuration
direct_axis.no_direction_option: Only one solution exists — no alternate positions

direction_field.purpose: When kinematic independent, machine may have 2 possible positions. Direction field selects which solution
direction_field.positive_negative: Controls which way rotary tips (toward/away from operator)

retract_strategies.z_retract: Move Z to extent of travel in plus direction
retract_strategies.max_tool_direction: Move tool out at current angle until near overtravel
retract_strategies.incremental: Small incremental move up from current position
retract_strategies.safety: Full retract recommended before rotary moves. Incremental retract for tracking mode

new_vs_additive.new: Cancels previous rotations, applies new rotation from original work coordinate zero. Like absolute positioning
new_vs_additive.additive: Builds on current rotation. Like incremental positioning. Useful for compound angles (e.g., 45 + 9 = 54 degree surface)

tracking.purpose: Tool follows rotation motion instead of retracting to Z max. Saves time on large machines
tracking.requirement: Machine must have TRAORI or ETRAORI (5-axis dynamic function) commissioned
tracking.caution: Tool may end up below surface during track — use adequate incremental retract before tracking
tracking.828d_note: 828D does NOT support TRAORI — no tracking option

cancellation.best_practice: Cancel at program end and before tool changes. Re-establish plane after tool change if builder's macro cancels it

safety_initialization.line_1: CYCLE800 with tool carrier enabled, retract to safe position, all rotations zero — squares up machine
safety_initialization.line_3: Safety line: G17 G54 G90 G71/G70 — tool plane, work coordinate, absolute mode, unit
safety_initialization.critical_order: Blank MUST come AFTER work coordinate and CYCLE800 cancel. If before, stock displays in wrong location

workpiece_blank.clamping_field: Required for 5-axis simulation. Set to C-axis for standard trunnion. If omitted, only 3-axis simulation shown

program_structure.before_tool_change: Cancel CYCLE800, retract to safe position, THEN do tool change. Never tool change with active rotation on head-head machines
program_structure.program_end: Retract to safe, cancel CYCLE800, M30

cadcam_integration.cycle_validation: Open any canned cycle in control mask to check for errors. Cycle mask validates parameter setup even if numeric values may be wrong

common_issues.swivel_data_name: Builder-definable, inconsistent across OEMs. Even same OEM uses different names across machine series
common_issues.workaround: Define string variable in header: DEF STRING[10] _SWIVEL = "TC_1" then use _SWIVEL in CYCLE800. Only change in one place
common_issues.empty_name: Leaving name blank works if machine has single swivel data record. NOT reliable for multi-record machines

cadcam_integration.comma_count: More commas = newer software version. Cycles are upward compatible — older format works in newer control
cadcam_integration.documentation: Job Planning Manual from support.industry.siemens.com → Chapter 19: Programming Cycles Externally. Details every variable position in each cycle
cadcam_integration.kinematic_mixed_output: CAD/CAM may mix independent rotations with dependent retract moves. Only retract lines need updating for different machine types

auto_mode_features.over_store_mode: MDI during active program. Cycle stop → over store → type command → cycle start. Machine returns to stop point and continues. Essential for 5-axis where simple Z retract may require coordinated multi-axis motion
auto_mode_features.block_search: Start from any point in program. System scans and establishes all modal states and rotations prior to selected block
auto_mode_features.collision_avoidance: Machine space model shows full kinematic during execution. Optional feature requiring commissioning
auto_mode_features.password_level: SUNRISE (all caps) = manufacturer level access for simulation activation and advanced features

sinutrain.availability: Free trial from CNC4You website (siemens CNC for you). Trial allows machine manipulation but not program import/export
sinutrain.full_version: Purchased license. Supports external program management and virtual machine building
sinutrain.virtual_machines: Can build exact replica from machine archive file. Archive: Ctrl+Alt+S (840D) or Ctrl+Alt+C (828D) to USB
sinutrain.version_licensing: License version limits software version (e.g., 4.5 license = up to 4.5 ed.3, need new license for 4.7)

videos.title: Setup & Programming Turn Mill B-Axis Lathes in ShopTurn
videos.focus: B-axis turn-mill lathe programming with ShopTurn
topics_covered: Turn mill vs mill turn terminology
Beta (B-axis angle) and Gamma (spindle orientation) fields
Dynamic offset calculation from B-axis center
Tool setup for B-axis (all tools built at B0/9 o'clock)
Work offset setup with mirrored G55 for counter spindle
Chuck/spindle data for automatic offset calculation
Part transfer between main and counter spindle
Face milling on B-axis lathes (Face Y only)
Swivel plane for inclined plane creation
Face B strategy for machining on inclined planes
Drilling on inclined planes with Face B strategy
Bolt hole patterns on inclined planes with C-axis rotation
Open slot milling with C-axis indexing
Repeat command with N-numbers for event repetition
Simulation with orientation verification via insert screw visual

turn_mill_vs_mill_turn.turn_mill: Base technology is a LATHE with milling functionality added. Primary control technology is turning. This is what video covers
turn_mill_vs_mill_turn.mill_turn: Base technology is a MILLING MACHINE with turning added (typically using torque motors on platter for high RPM turning)
turn_mill_vs_mill_turn.distinction: Industry terminology shift to clarify base machine technology and primary control mode

b_axis_fundamentals.b_zero_position: Typically at 9 o'clock (tool pointing at main spindle/headstock). Builder-configurable but this is most common
b_axis_fundamentals.rotation_convention: Positive B rotation = counterclockwise. B45 = 7:30 position, B90 = 6 o'clock, B180 = 3 o'clock (facing sub spindle)
b_axis_fundamentals.reference_datum: Center of B rotary axis. Dynamic offset from rotary center to spindle face gauge line managed by control's kinematics engine
b_axis_fundamentals.offset_tracking: When B-axis moves via beta field, control automatically recalculates tool position. Linear axis display changes even without physical linear motion — this is dynamic offset compensation
b_axis_fundamentals.beta_vs_direct_b: Using beta field in TSM/cycles = dynamic offset tracking. Using direct B axis position = NO offset recalculation. ALWAYS use beta/gamma fields for proper compensation
b_axis_fundamentals.controller: B-axis functionality requires 840D sl — NOT available on 828D
b_axis_fundamentals.typical_config: X, Y, Z linear + B rotary + C main spindle + sub spindle. HSK63 or similar tool interface

beta_and_gamma.beta: B-axis rotation angle. Controls tool swing position around B rotary
beta_and_gamma.gamma: Milling spindle orientation angle. Controls rotation of tool in spindle (like M19 orient)
beta_and_gamma.combined_use: Beta=0, Gamma=0 = tool at 9 o'clock, OD turning. Beta=0, Gamma=180 = tool flipped for boring. Beta=90 = tool pointing down for face work. Beta=90, Gamma=180 = face work from opposite side
beta_and_gamma.tsm_shortcuts: Arrow left = B0, Arrow down = B90, Arrow right = B180
beta_and_gamma.in_cycles: Available in turning cycles. NOT in milling cycles (milling cycles determine B position from face/peripheral selection)
beta_and_gamma.simulation_verification: Watch for insert screw visual — visible means specific orientation. If screw disappears, tool has been flipped

tool_setup.orientation_rule: ALL tools built as if at B0 (9 o'clock position). System handles all orientation changes via beta/gamma
tool_setup.turning_tools: Right-hand = first orientation position (OD at B0). Left-hand = third position (boring at B0). System auto-flips for sub spindle work
tool_setup.rotary_tools: No X offset needed (concentric to spindle center). Only WF (gauge line to tip distance) and diameter required. Always built pointing toward headstock at B0

multi_tool.purpose: Multiple tool types in single tool pocket (e.g., roughing + finishing + threading inserts on one holder)
multi_tool.setup: Create multi-tool → name + number of locations → optionally specify angles between locations → build each cutting edge as normal
multi_tool.mt_column: MT indicator in tool table. Requires positionable (orientable) spindle
multi_tool.tool_change: Select by name → system loads entire multi-tool assembly → orients spindle to selected location number

gauge_line.hsk: HSK mount: gauge line at spindle face (contact surface)
gauge_line.cat40: CAT40: gauge line inside spindle, even on BIG Plus. Must know distance to face
gauge_line.critical_dimension: Distance from B rotary center to gauge line is managed by control. If incorrect, all B-axis orientations will have position errors

work_offset_strategy.main_spindle: G54 — standard work coordinate at main spindle face
work_offset_strategy.sub_spindle: G55 — MIRRORED in Z. Mirror handles: Z direction, beta/gamma orientation flip, spindle direction reversal. Dramatically simplifies sub spindle programming
work_offset_strategy.describe_function: Can auto-calculate G55 from G54 + chuck data. Overwrites existing offset — use cautiously. Good for production (prevents operator offset changes)
work_offset_strategy.chuck_spindle_data: Offset table → Setting Data → Chuck body and jaw projection distances. MUST be accurate for automatic G55 calculation and part transfer
work_offset_strategy.programming_rule: ALWAYS program as if on main spindle. Mirrored G55 automatically handles all orientation, direction, and position changes for sub spindle operations

turning_with_b_axis.stock_removal: Same cycle as standard turning plus beta/gamma fields
turning_with_b_axis.orientation_examples: B0/G0 = standard OD right-hand. B90/G180 = tool inverted for face. B0/G180 = boring with right-hand tool
turning_with_b_axis.simulation_tip: If chosen orientation is not viable, simulation will catch error

part_transfer.same_as_sub_spindle: Pick-and-place transfer with additional beta/gamma positioning during transfer
part_transfer.clearance_warning: B-axis head is physically large — ensure adequate clearance during transfer. Account for longest tool + full head envelope
part_transfer.g55_mirror: After transfer, system automatically handles all direction and orientation changes. No manual adjustment needed

milling_operations.no_beta_gamma: Milling cycles do NOT have beta/gamma fields. B position determined by face vs peripheral selection
milling_operations.face_c: C-axis rotation (spindle indexes) for face milling
milling_operations.face_y: Y-axis linear motion for face milling. Y-axis required
milling_operations.peripheral_c: Wrapped around part OD using C-axis
milling_operations.face_b: NEW — for machining on inclined planes created by swivel cycle. MUST have active swivel plane
milling_operations.face_mill_note: Face milling only available as Face Y (not peripheral C). Facing is inherently flat

inclined_planes.swivel_cycle: Creates inclined plane with tool perpendicular to surface. Identical concept to CYCLE800 on 5-axis mills
inclined_planes.parameters: C orientation, linear shift (X0/Y0/Z0), rotation axis and angle, secondary shift on new plane
inclined_planes.workflow: 1) Create swivel plane, 2) Use Face B strategy in milling/drilling cycle, 3) Cancel swivel plane when done
inclined_planes.face_b_requirement: Any cycle on inclined plane MUST use Face B. Face Y or Sheet Y will negate the swivel plane
inclined_planes.c_axis_bolt_pattern: Can drill bolt hole patterns around inclined plane using Face B with C-axis rotation option

centric_drilling.concept: Tool held stationary (no spindle), workpiece spins in main/sub spindle
centric_drilling.b_limitation: Only B0 or B180 — cannot drill at arbitrary B angles in centric mode
centric_drilling.tool_type: Solid drill (insert-style, flat bottom assumed — no tip angle required)

slotting.open_slot: Face or peripheral with C-axis indexing
slotting.c_orientation: Clock position of slot feature. 0 = reference position, 90 = 90 degrees rotated
slotting.indexing: Multiple features clocked relative to each other using C orientation field

repeat_command.syntax: REPEAT N[start] N[end] — repeats all events between specified sequence numbers
repeat_command.prerequisite: Must have N-numbers assigned via renumber function
repeat_command.use_case: Avoid copy/paste of identical operations on opposite sides. Single source of truth
repeat_command.goto: GOTOB/GOTOF with N-number for program flow control

g_codes.G18: XZ plane selection (right angle head orientation)
g_codes.G55: Work coordinate system 2 (commonly used for sub spindle with Z mirror)
g_codes.G94: Feed rate in mm/min or inches/min
g_codes.G95: Feed rate in mm/rev or inches/rev
g_codes.G96: Constant surface speed (CSS) — spindle varies RPM to maintain surface footage

m_codes.M1: Optional stop (only stops when optional stop flag is set)

drilling.CYCLE83: Deep hole drilling / peck drilling with full retract
drilling.CYCLE86: Boring with oriented spindle stop and retract
drilling.CYCLE87: Boring with spindle stop at depth
drilling.CYCLE88: Boring with dwell and spindle stop

CYCLE800.name: Swivel cycle / plane rotation
CYCLE800.purpose: 3+2 indexed positioning. Creates inclined work plane and orients coordinate system
CYCLE800.cancel: CYCLE800() — empty parentheses cancels all rotations and tool carrier

parameters.tracking: Requires TRAORI/ETRAORI. Tool follows rotation. Not on 828D

other.CYCLE832: High speed machining settings (tolerance, COMPCAD/COMPCURV activation)
other.TRANSMIT: Polar coordinate transformation for face milling on lathes (C-axis interpolation)
other.TRACYL: Cylinder surface transformation for peripheral milling on lathes
other.TRAORI: 5-axis orientation transformation (simultaneous 5-axis). Required for tracking in CYCLE800
other.TCARR: Tool carrier activation (loads kinematic chain data)
other.COMPCAD: Spline-based contour smoothing for high speed machining
other.COMPCURV: Curvature-based contour compression for high speed machining

sinumerik_functions.TSM_screen: Tool/Spindle/M-code manual control interface in jog mode
sinumerik_functions.measure_tool: Manual or automatic tool offset setting with Set Length function
sinumerik_functions.measure_workpiece: Work coordinate setting with Set Work Coordinate function
sinumerik_functions.align_edge: 2-point edge measurement for workpiece alignment (coordinate rotation or direct axis)
sinumerik_functions.swivel_jog: Simplified CYCLE800 in jog mode for setup. Drive to rotated position, cancel rotations, return to machine zero
sinumerik_functions.sync_thread: Thread repair/re-synchronization. Engage tool in thread, teach spindle orientation
sinumerik_functions.over_store: MDI mode during active program execution. Critical for 5-axis retract from angled positions
sinumerik_functions.block_search: Start program from any line. System establishes all modal states
sinumerik_functions.basic_blocks: Display resulting G-code from conversational ShopMill/ShopTurn programs
sinumerik_functions.simultaneous_record: Real-time simulation graphics during auto mode execution
sinumerik_functions.residual_material: Automatic detection and machining of areas unreachable by primary tool

sinumerik_variables.R_parameters: User variables R0-R99 for parametric programming
sinumerik_variables.DEF_STRING: Define string variable (e.g., DEF STRING[10] _SWIVEL for portable cycle names)

tool_offsets.geometry: Length X (L1), Length Z (L2), Radius, Tip direction, Insert angle, Relief angle, IC, Insert width
tool_offsets.wear: Separate wear columns for incremental adjustment
tool_offsets.d_numbers: D1-D9 per tool for multiple cutting edges

work_offsets.fields: X, Y, Z linear + Coordinate rotations (details) + Direct axis A, B, C
work_offsets.coordinate_rotations: Rotation about X, Y, Z linear axes (in Details). Used for kinematic independent 5-axis
work_offsets.direct_axis: Direct rotary axis offset. Used for kinematic dependent programming

offset_system.tool_life_management: Built-in tool life tracking by time, parts count, or wear measurement
offset_system.magazine_management: Random tool changer management for milling machines

extensions.MPF: Main Program File — required for part programs in NC memory

file_system.naming_rules: Letters, numbers, underscores ONLY. No spaces, dashes, decimals, or special characters
file_system.nc_memory_structure: Part Programs folder (MPF only) → Sub Programs folder → Workpieces folder (subdirectories, any extension)
file_system.storage_options: NC internal memory, local drive (expanded), USB, CF card, network mapped drive

840d_only: Multi-channel capability (e.g., robot loading as separate channel)
both_828d_and_840d: ProgramGuide G-code editor with cycle support

practical_tips.offset_verification: After setting ANY offset, verify display position changed. If unchanged, troubleshoot immediately — do not proceed
practical_tips.usb_warning: Never use USB as primary program storage in production. Unreliable connection, security risk. Use network drive or internal memory
practical_tips.program_naming: Only letters, numbers, underscores. Use descriptive names with underscores (e.g., WIDGET_OP10_ROUGH)
practical_tips.tool_naming: Siemens allows full text tool names. Embed info: 'CNMG_432_3-32_OD' is clearer than 'T01'
practical_tips.feed_per_tooth: Use feed per tooth with number of flutes defined — system auto-calculates feed rate. If tool changes, engagement changes automatically
practical_tips.css_vs_rpm: Use CSS (G96) for turning OD work — maintains consistent surface speed. Use RPM (G97) for drilling, threading, and at spindle nose
practical_tips.insert_position: In conversational editor, new events insert BELOW highlighted event. Keep highlight above insertion point
practical_tips.relief_angle_convention: Always add to 90 degrees: 3-degree clearance = enter 93, 5-degree = enter 95, 7-degree = enter 97
practical_tips.simulation_speed: Ctrl+M toggles max simulation speed. Program control overrides (separate from machine overrides) adjust speed. Simulation feed override does NOT affect machine execution
practical_tips.cycle800_before_tool_change: Always cancel CYCLE800 and retract BEFORE tool change on head-head machines. Tool change with active rotation can cause collision
practical_tips.coordinate_rotation_consistency: If using coordinate rotations for align plane, use coordinate rotations for align edge too. Never mix with direct axis offsets
practical_tips.b_axis_clearance: B-axis head is physically large. Account for full head envelope plus longest tool when calculating clearances during tool change and part transfer
practical_tips.describe_caution: Describe field in header overwrites work offset table values. Avoid in setup — use only in proven production programs
practical_tips.inclined_plane_strategy: Any machining on inclined plane MUST use Face B strategy. Face Y or Sheet Y reverts to original coordinate system
practical_tips.shopturn_to_gcode: ShopTurn programs CANNOT be converted to G-code or vice versa. However, Basic Blocks view shows resulting G-code for reference
practical_tips.thread_mill_formula: F_actual = F_programmed * (D_thread / D_tool) for internal. Control calculates automatically from linear feed rate. Use catalog linear feed — system compensates for thread/tool diameter ratio
practical_tips.multi_axis_jogging: After coordinate rotation, use WCS/MCS toggle to control jog direction relative to rotated or machine coordinates. Essential for setup on 5-axis
practical_tips.password_sunrise: Type SUNRISE (all caps) in password field to access manufacturer-level settings. May be needed for simulation activation on some machines

alarm_troubleshooting.cycle_mask_validation: Open any canned cycle in editor to check parameter validity. System flags setup errors (e.g., missing direction for axis-by-axis mode)
alarm_troubleshooting.accept_key_missing: If Accept key disappears when filling out cycle, a parameter is out of range. Error message displayed above Edit key
alarm_troubleshooting.strategy_mismatch: Drilling positions must use same strategy as drilling cycle (Face B, Face Y, etc.). Mismatched strategies won't link
alarm_troubleshooting.overtravel: Tracking with too-small retract can cause overtravel alarm. Increase incremental retract distance
alarm_troubleshooting.offset_consistency: Mixed coordinate rotation and direct axis offsets in work coordinate cause unpredictable behavior. Use one method consistently
